WITH ordered_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        stamp,
        path,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as visit_num
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/detail/')
),
detail_sequences AS (
    SELECT 
        v1.session,
        v1.stamp as detail1_stamp,
        v1.path as detail1_path,
        v2.stamp as detail2_stamp,
        v2.path as detail2_path,
        v3.stamp as third_stamp,
        v3.path as third_path
    FROM ordered_visits v1
    JOIN ordered_visits v2 ON v1.session = v2.session AND v2.visit_num = v1.visit_num + 1
    JOIN ordered_visits v3 ON v2.session = v3.session AND v3.visit_num = v2.visit_num + 1
    WHERE v1.path IN ('/detail', '/detail/')
      AND v2.path IN ('/detail', '/detail/')
)
SELECT third_path, COUNT(*) as visit_count
FROM detail_sequences
GROUP BY third_path
ORDER BY visit_count DESC
LIMIT 10
</parameter>
